CustomObject.description: Confirmed link between the two legs (debit/credit) of one internal transfer between bank accounts of the same holder. Both AXF_OBJ_BankAccountTransaction__c legs stay independent, immutable facts; only the link is created here. Service-owner root (AXF-32): no raw share to the end user, read only via a redacted DTO after validating access to both legs.
CustomObject.label: Internal transfer
